Scope and uncertainty

152 compute nodes: 132 NSF/NAIRR-funded and 20 Illinois Computes-funded. Four Grace-Hopper superchips per node. Node specifications follow the documented NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper Superchip platform (Superchip module — nodes per system and per-node superchip counts are operator-specific); operator-specific deviations are not published.
